description: Heuristic risk screen for a Solana token mint: mint/freeze authority, Token-2022 extensions (permanent delegate, transfer hook/fee, default-frozen, pausable...), metadata mutability, holder concentration, DEX liquidity and pair age (DexScreener), Jupiter verification. Returns a 0-100 score with itemised flags. Read-only; not a security guarantee. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sol-token-risk

include_holders.description: Fetch top holders (getTokenLargestAccounts) for concentration analysis; default true
